facts.fact: Under the World Bank-financed Central African Backbone, Congo has been interconnected to Gabon since 2018, operated commercially since 2019 by Mambs Services, the Treasury sheet says.
The Treasury sheet says Congo has been connected to Cameroon through the CAB project since 2022.
The Treasury sheet says Congo Telecom's underwater river cable has linked Brazzaville to Kinshasa in the DRC since 2017.
